This table was generated with LanceDB Rust **0.27.2**, Lance **4.0.0**, and Arrow **57.2.0**, with the connection explicitly configured to create **V2.2** data files. Its physical data footer records `(2, 2)`.

The schema, records, and three B-tree indexes match the [old default-format fixture](../lancedb-0.27.2/README.md). Use its shared generator with `v2.2` after the output directory to reproduce this variant. Regression tests copy the table to a temporary directory before modifying it.
